name: lcs both empty
why: Empty prefix has LCS 0.

name: lcs one empty
why: If either string is empty the answer is 0 and "".

name: lcs subsequence not substring
why: team is a subsequence of tea_time (t,e,a, then m) but not a substring.

name: lcs repeated characters
why: a=aaaa, b=aa: only two a's can be matched.

name: lcs alternative optima
why: ab vs ba: both 'a' and 'b' are optimal (length 1); either is accepted.

name: lcs case and punctuation
why: A and a differ; spaces/punctuation are normal characters: common 'b, c'.

name: merge no blocks
why: n=0: nothing to merge.

name: merge one block
why: n=1: already one block.

name: merge README example
why: (2+3)=5 then 5+4=9: total 14; the other order gives 7+9=16.

name: merge adjacency matters
why: [1,100,1]: greedy would merge the two 1's, but they are not adjacent. Any valid order costs 101+102=203.

name: merge zeros and ties
why: All zero sizes: every plan costs 0; several plans are optimal.

name: merge large total
why: Two blocks of 1e9 and one more: (1e9+1e9) + 3e9 = 5e9 > 2^31.

name: tree empty
why: n=0: empty set, weight 0.

name: tree single positive
why: One vertex with weight 5 is taken.

name: tree all negative
why: The empty set (weight 0) beats any negative choice.

name: tree README example
why: 4+6 = 10 > 9 (middle only).

name: tree star
why: Centre 10 vs four leaves 3+3+3+3=12: take the leaves.

name: tree zero weights and ties
why: Zero-weight vertices add nothing; 5 at 0 or 5 at 2 with 0 between: best 10 from {0,2}.

name: tree large sum
why: Two non-adjacent leaves of 1e9 and one of 1e9: 3e9 > 2^31.

name: naive empty pattern
why: Empty pattern matches every boundary 0..n: 4 starts for 'abc'.

name: kmp empty pattern empty text
why: n=0: one boundary, position 0.

name: rk empty text
why: Nonempty pattern cannot fit in empty text.

name: kmp pattern longer
why: m > n returns [].

name: naive overlaps
why: aaa occurs at 0,1,2 in aaaaa (overlaps count).

name: kmp overlaps after full match
why: Fallback pi after a match keeps starts 2 and 4.

name: kmp case and punctuation
why: Case-sensitive: 'A.b' matches only at 4, not 'a.b' at 0.

name: rk known collision ab/dj
why: ab and dj both hash to 75 (base 31, mod 101). dj must be rejected by character check.

name: rk collision as pattern
why: Pattern dj: window ab is an equal-hash candidate that must be rejected.

name: rk negative remainder
why: Removing a large leftmost char code makes the intermediate value negative; it must be normalized. '~' is code 126.

name: rk overlaps and empty pattern
why: Shared contract with KMP: 2 boundaries for text 'x'.

name: suffix empty
why: Empty text: all three empty.

name: suffix one char
why: Only suffix 0; no repeat.

name: suffix all equal
why: aaaa: shorter suffix is smaller -> sa 3,2,1,0; lcp 0,1,2,3; repeat 'aaa' at 0 and 1 (overlap).

name: suffix all distinct
why: dcba: all characters distinct -> no repeat, lcp all 0.

name: suffix banana
why: Published example; ana occurs at 1 and 3 (overlapping).

name: suffix tied longest repeats
why: abxabcdycd: 'ab' and 'cd' both repeat with length 2; either is accepted.

name: aho empty dictionary
why: p=0: one empty row per text.

name: aho no texts
why: texts=[] gives counts=[].

name: aho duplicates, suffix patterns, empty text, independent texts
why: he is a suffix of she, so it is counted inside 'she'. Duplicate 'he' gets the same count. Second identical text starts fresh. Empty text gives zeros.

name: aho overlaps and nested
why: In 'aaaa': 'a' 4 times, 'aa' 3, 'aaa' 2 (overlaps counted).
